target: 未来7天出现19类军事行动报道
sample_dependence_note: Rolling historical windows overlap and the same article may appear under several cases; samples are correlated and validation uncertainty is not estimated as independent trials.
target_semantics: Probability that the supplied news stream contains at least one automatically detected CAMEO-19 report in the next 7 days; not independently verified real-event occurrence probability.

detector.score_semantics: uncalibrated semantic detector score, not event occurrence probability

aliases.description: Conservative actor aliases used only for weak pre-labelling. Strong aliases identify a principal actor; context aliases identify the relevant theatre but cannot produce a yes label by themselves.

historical_window_note: 训练使用28–92天可用历史；并非每个锚点均有完整三个月。

provenance.source: project news and GPT/Codex pilot evidence only
provenance.labels: detector-derived future-report proxy; zero means no detected report in covered supplied news, not absence of real action
provenance.future_coverage_selection: Only historical anchors with at least 3 distinct future news days are labelled. This creates selection bias; metrics and fitted probabilities describe the covered supplied-news subset, not an arbitrary future week.
provenance.normalization_fit: train-only during selection; train+eligible-validation for final fit
provenance.text_coverage: title and first 6500 cleaned body characters, at most 25 sentence chunks

build_contract.target: Future seven days contain a locally detected CAMEO-19 report in the supplied news stream
